_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pelican-eggs/games-standalone (MIT).
name: The Battle for Wesnoth
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The turn-based fantasy strategy game's multiplayer server, for players to meet in a lobby and host games. Installs Debian's build of the Wesnoth 1.18 server, checked against Debian's checksums.
startup: rm -f .wesnothd/socket; mkdir -p .wesnothd; LD_LIBRARY_PATH=wesnoth/lib wesnoth/wesnothd -c wesnothd.cfg -p {{SERVER_PORT}} & p=$!; while kill -0 $p 2>/dev/null; do if read -r -t 1 l; then [ -p .wesnothd/socket ] && printf "%s\n" "$l" > .wesnothd/socket; elif [ $? -lt 128 ]; then sleep 1; fi; done; wait $p

config.startup: {"done": "Server commands may be written to this file."}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# The Battle for Wesnoth. Installs Debian's build of the Wesnoth multiplayer
# server (wesnothd) and the Boost libraries it needs, checked against
# Debian's checksums, into wesnoth/. wesnothd.cfg (your settings) is never
# touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
mirror=https://deb.debian.org/debian
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64 ;;
*) fail "Wesnoth's server isn't built for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
# Debian 13's package lists: the backports (newer Wesnoth releases) first.
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build/x"
for dist in trixie-backports trixie; do
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 "$mirror/dists/$dist/main/binary-$arch/Packages.xz" | xz -d > "$build/$dist" ||
        fail "Debian's package lists can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
done
# field <package> <Field>: the field of the newest list that has the package.
field() {
    for dist in trixie-backports trixie; do
        v=$(awk -v RS= -v p="$1" -v f="$2" '$0 ~ "(^|\n)Package: " p "\n" {
            n = split($0, l, "\n"); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (index(l[i], f ": ") == 1) { print substr(l[i], length(f) + 3); exit } }' "$build/$dist")
        if [ -n "$v" ]; then echo "$v"; return; fi
    done
}

server=wesnoth-1.18-server
version=$(field "$server" Version)
[ -n "$version" ] || fail "Debian has no Wesnoth server right now. Reinstall to try again later."
version=${version#*:}; version=${version%%-*}
if [ -x wesnoth/wesnothd ] && [ "$(cat wesnoth/version 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $arch" ]; then
    echo "Wesnoth's server $version is already installed."
else
    # The server and the Boost libraries it needs, which the runtime image
    # doesn't have; the image has everything else.
    pkgs=("$server") i=0
    while [ "$i" -lt "${#pkgs[@]}" ]; do
        for d in $(field "${pkgs[$i]}" Depends | tr ',' '\n' | awk '{ print $1 }' | grep '^libboost-' || true); do
            [[ " ${pkgs[*]} " == *" $d "* ]] || pkgs+=("$d")
        done
        i=$((i + 1))
    done
    echo "Downloading Wesnoth's server $version from Debian"
    for p in "${pkgs[@]}"; do
        file=$(field "$p" Filename) sum=$(field "$p" SHA256)
        [ -n "$file" ] && [ -n "$sum" ] || fail "Debian's package list has no $p. Reinstall to try again later."
        curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o "$build/$p.deb" "$mirror/$file" || fail "The download of $p failed. Reinstall to try again."
        [ "$(sha256sum "$build/$p.deb" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ] || fail "$p didn't match Debian's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
        dpkg-deb -x "$build/$p.deb" "$build/x"
    done
    mkdir -p "$build/new/lib"
    mv "$build/x/usr/games/wesnothd-1.18" "$build/new/wesnothd"
    find "$build/x/usr/lib" -name 'libboost_*.so*' -exec mv {} "$build/new/lib/" \;
    echo "$version $arch" > "$build/new/version"
    rm -rf wesnoth && mv "$build/new" wesnoth
fi

mkdir -p .wesnothd
if [ ! -f wesnothd.cfg ]; then
    cat > wesnothd.cfg <<'CFG'
# Wesnoth server settings: https://wiki.wesnoth.org/ServerAdministration
# The message of the day and the admin password are set from the server's
# variables at start.
motd=""
passwd=""
fifo_path="/home/container/.wesnothd/socket"
versions_accepted="1.18*"
max_messages=4
messages_time_period=10
connections_allowed=5
CFG
fi
# The console sends commands through this file (servers from older eggs
# have a wesnothd.cfg without it).
grep -q '^fifo_path=' wesnothd.cfg || echo 'fifo_path="/home/container/.wesnothd/socket"' >> wesnothd.cfg
echo "Installed Wesnoth's server $version."

variables.name: Message of the day
variables.description: The message players see when they join the lobby.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for /query admin, which makes a player a server admin. Empty turns it off.
